verdict.rationale: Otter documents scheduling its AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all Zoom, Teams, and Google Meet meetings, which covers automatic capture. Nothing in the evidence explicitly names a Google or Outlook calendar connection, and nothing shows per-meeting-type rules for choosing which meetings get captured. missing for 10: explicit Google/Outlook calendar connection documentation, per-meeting-type or rule-based auto-capture controls, independent or hands-on corroboration of those controls.

support.subject: As a product manager, I connect Google or Outlook calendar once and control per-meeting-type rules for which meetings get captured automatically

citations.quote: Schedule your AI Meeting Notetaker to automatically join all your Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings.
